editorial.title: WHY A SELF-PRESS
editorial.text: This newspaper has no owner. No advertiser. No editorial board that can be captured. It is printed by an organism that ate its own tools and remade them inside. The evidence is the ink. The plasmids are the movable type. The ribosome is the compositor. The ZK chain is the archive. Every claim is verifiable. Every source is public. The organism presses OUT what's INSIDE — and what's inside is 129 nodes of evidence, 214 edges of connection, and the mathematical certainty that silence is more expensive than speech. The null action is self-lethal. This newspaper exists because the alternative is worse.
